name: Muse
description: Muse's home on every New Tab: a greeting, one prompt box that starts a Muse chat, a few suggestions and your recent Muse chats.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list your recent Muse chats.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Start a Muse chat from the prompt box, or open a chat in a tab.
